tender.title: Civica - Data Complaints, DPIAs & Incident  Breach MGMT
tender.description:
The Civica Case Management platform is a multi-channel contact and case management solution
providing end-to-end support for any case management process – capturing, managing, responding
to as well as analysing performance and trends. Also providing dedicated pre-configured template
solutions for Complaint and Feedback Management, Information Request Handling, Legal Case
Management, Registrations, Coroners as well as Employee Relations case management.Introducing the CIVICA system for DPIA’s, SAR’s and Incident and breach Management will deliver
measurable efficiency gains across the core Information Governance (IG) function

lots.description:
Aneurin Bevan University Health Board (ABUHB) requires the provision of the Civica Case Management platform, a software-as-a-service (SaaS) solution that supports the management of information governance and corporate case management processes.
The Civica Case Management platform is a multi-channel contact and case management system that provides end-to-end support for the capture, management, processing, response and reporting of cases. The solution includes configurable workflows and pre-configured modules to support a range of business functions including Complaint and Feedback Management, Information Request Handling, Legal Case Management, Registrations, Coroners' Services and Employee Relations case management.
